name: zenOS Development
install:
set -e
dpkg -s python3.12-venv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq python3.12-venv; }
if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then rm -rf .venv; python3 -m venv .venv; fi
. .venv/bin/activate
if [ -f _setup.py.bak ] && [ ! -f setup.py ]; then mv _setup.py.bak setup.py; fi
pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel -q
pip install pyyaml click rich jinja2 pydantic aiohttp python-dotenv prompt-toolkit beautifulsoup4 schedule aiofiles psutil -q
if [ -f setup.py ]; then mv setup.py _setup.py.bak; fi
pip install --no-build-isolation -e '.[dev]' -q
if [ -f _setup.py.bak ]; then mv _setup.py.bak setup.py; fi
pip install flake8 isort bandit -q
if [ -f env.example ] && [ ! -f .env ]; then cp env.example .env; fi
